other_conditions: Startup must have an innovative tech-based idea/solution
Must be registered as a legal entity in Karnataka (e.g., Pvt Ltd, OPC, LLP, Partnership, Proprietorship)
At least one co‑founder must belong to SC or ST community or hold a substantial share
SC/ST co‑founder must remain with the business for at least one year after receiving benefits
Ownership terms must not be altered to the disadvantage of the SC/ST co‑founder
Total turnover since incorporation must be less than INR 50 crore
At least 50% of the workforce must be based in Karnataka
For technology‑based startups, age of company must be less than 4 years; for biotechnology, less than 7 years
Start‑ups under social impact must demonstrate benefits to Scheduled Caste community
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs 50 lakh financial support to eligible SC/ST entrepreneurs for tech‑based startup development.
